points.title: 童年与早期教育
points.description: 1854年10月20日，兰波出生于法国北部阿登省的沙勒维尔。他的父亲弗雷德里克·兰波是拿破仑军队的骑兵上尉，母亲维多利亚是一个农民家庭的女儿。兰波是家中长子，下面还有两个弟弟和两个妹妹。他的父母关系紧张，父亲在兰波幼年时离家出走，留下母亲独自抚养五个孩子。兰波从小展现出非凡的智力，8岁开始写诗，12岁就能熟练运用拉丁语和希腊语。在沙勒维尔中学期间，他开始创作诗歌，并展现出叛逆的性格，经常逃学和阅读禁书。
points.descriptionEn: Born on October 20, 1854, in Charleville, northern France, Rimbaud was the eldest of five children. His father, Frédéric Rimbaud, was a cavalry captain who abandoned the family when Arthur was young, leaving his mother, Vitalie, to raise the children alone. Rimbaud displayed exceptional intelligence from an early age, writing poetry at 8 and mastering Latin and Greek by 12. At the Collège de Charleville, he began composing poetry and developed a rebellious nature, frequently skipping classes to read forbidden books.

points.title: 巴黎文坛初露锋芒
points.description: 1870年，兰波离开沙勒维尔前往巴黎，试图参加诗歌比赛并引起文学界的注意。在巴黎期间，他遇到了著名诗人保罗·魏尔伦，两人迅速建立了深厚的友谊和复杂的情感关系。1871年，兰波创作了著名的《地狱一季》和《醉舟》等诗作，这些作品展现了他超前的现代主义风格和对传统诗歌的突破。兰波在巴黎的生活放荡不羁，经常出入咖啡馆和酒吧，与巴黎的波西米亚艺术家群体交往密切。这一时期，他的诗歌开始展现出对传统道德和宗教的挑战，以及对感官体验的极致追求。
points.descriptionEn: In 1870, Rimbaud left Charleville for Paris, aiming to enter poetry competitions and gain attention from the literary world. There he met the famous poet Paul Verlaine, with whom he quickly developed a deep friendship and complex emotional relationship. In 1871, Rimbaud wrote his famous works 'A Season in Hell' and 'The Drunken Boat', showcasing his超前 modernist style and breaking with traditional poetry. His life in Paris was bohemian, frequenting cafes and bars and associating closely with Paris's artistic circles. During this period, his poetry began to challenge traditional morality and religion while pursuing sensory experiences to the extreme.

points.title: 与魏尔伦的欧洲之旅
points.description: 1872年，兰波与魏尔伦开始了一段充满激情但动荡的关系，两人一起前往比利时布鲁塞尔，后又前往伦敦。在这段时期，兰波继续创作诗歌，同时与魏尔伦的关系变得越来越不稳定。1873年7月，魏尔伦在醉酒状态下开枪打伤了兰波的手腕，导致兰波返回沙勒维尔养伤。这一事件标志着两人关系的终结。在布鲁塞尔期间，兰波完成了《地狱一季》的创作，这是一部自传性的散文诗作品，记录了他与魏尔伦的关系以及他对诗歌和生活的思考。这部作品展现了他对传统道德的彻底挑战和对'诗人必须打乱所有感官'理念的实践。
points.descriptionEn: In 1872, Rimbaud began a passionate but tumultuous relationship with Verlaine, traveling together to Brussels, Belgium, and later to London. During this period, Rimbaud continued writing poetry while his relationship with Verlaine became increasingly unstable. In July 1873, Verlaine shot and wounded Rimbaud's wrist in a drunken rage, causing Rimbaud to return to Charleville to recover. This event marked the end of their relationship. In Brussels, Rimbaud completed 'A Season in Hell', an autobiographical prose poem documenting his relationship with Verlaine and his thoughts on poetry and life. This work demonstrated his complete challenge to traditional morality and his practice of the idea that 'the poet must make himself a seer'.

points.title: 创作高峰与自我反思
points.description: 1873年回到沙勒维尔后，兰波完成了《地狱一季》的创作，并于1873年出版。这部作品是他早期诗歌创作的总结，也是他对自己诗人身份的反思。1875年，兰波创作了《灵光集》，这是一部更加成熟和系统的作品，展现了他对诗歌理论的深入思考。在这一时期，兰波开始质疑自己的诗歌创作，认为诗人应该通过'打乱所有感官'来达到'灵光'状态。他提出了著名的'诗人必须打乱所有感官'的理念，认为诗人应该通过各种感官体验来获得超越性的洞察力。这一时期，兰波的诗歌风格更加成熟，对传统诗歌形式的突破也更加彻底。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to Charleville in 1873, Rimbaud completed 'A Season in Hell', which was published the same year. This work was a culmination of his early poetic creations and a reflection on his identity as a poet. In 1875, Rimbaud wrote 'Illuminations', a more mature and systematic work that showcased his deep thinking on poetic theory. During this period, Rimbaud began to question his own poetic creation, proposing that poets should achieve a state of 'illumination' by 'disordering all the senses'. He put forward the famous concept that 'the poet must make himself a seer', believing that poets should gain transcendent insight through various sensory experiences. During this time, Rimbaud's poetic style became more mature, and his break with traditional poetic forms became more thorough.

points.title: 漂泊与军旅生涯
points.description: 1876年，兰波开始了他长达15年的漂泊生活，先后在荷兰、德国、奥地利、意大利和瑞士等地游历。1876年，他短暂加入了荷兰殖民军队，前往爪哇，但因疾病提前返回欧洲。1878年，他再次参军，这次是加入了法国殖民军队，前往塞浦路斯。1880年，兰波彻底放弃了诗歌创作，转而投身于商业活动。他开始在埃及的亚历山大港从事咖啡贸易，后来又在埃塞俄比亚的哈拉尔从事象牙和咖啡贸易。这一时期，兰波的生活充满了冒险和商业活动，他学会了多种语言，包括阿拉伯语和阿姆哈拉语，并逐渐从诗人转变为商人和探险家。
points.descriptionEn: In 1876, Rimbaud began his 15-year wandering life, traveling through the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Italy, and Switzerland. In 1876, he briefly joined the Dutch colonial army and went to Java but returned to Europe early due to illness. In 1878, he enlisted again, this time in the French colonial army, and went to Cyprus. By 1880, Rimbaud had completely abandoned poetry and turned to business activities. He began trading coffee in Alexandria, Egypt, and later dealt in ivory and coffee in Harar, Ethiopia. During this period, Rimbaud's life was filled with adventure and business; he learned multiple languages including Arabic and Amharic, gradually transforming from a poet into a merchant and explorer.

points.title: 非洲商人生涯与晚年
points.titleEn: African Business Career and Later Years
points.description: 1880年后，兰波在非洲东部建立了自己的商业网络，主要在埃塞俄比亚和索马里地区从事象牙、咖啡和武器贸易。他学会了当地语言，与当地部落建立了良好的关系，并成为法国在东非的非官方代表。1884年，兰波在哈拉尔建立了自己的贸易站，并雇佣了当地助手。1887年，他因商业纠纷被当地人袭击，导致左腿严重受伤，被迫截肢。1891年11月10日，兰波在法国马赛的一家医院去世，年仅37岁。他的晚年生活虽然远离了诗歌创作，但他的诗歌影响却在欧洲文学界逐渐扩大。兰波的诗歌作品在他去世后由他的朋友整理出版，对后来的象征主义和超现实主义文学产生了深远影响，被誉为现代诗歌的先驱之一。
points.descriptionEn: After 1880, Rimbaud established his own business network in East Africa, dealing primarily in ivory, coffee, and weapons in Ethiopia and Somalia. He learned local languages, built good relationships with local tribes, and became an unofficial representative of France in East Africa. In 1884, Rimbaud established his own trading post in Harar and hired local assistants. In 1887, he was attacked by locals due to a business dispute, resulting in a severe injury to his left leg that required amputation. On November 10, 1891, Rimbaud died in a hospital in Marseille, France, at the age of 37. Although his later life was far from poetry, his poetic influence gradually expanded in European literary circles. His works were published posthumously by his friends and had a profound impact on later Symbolist and Surrealist literature, earning him recognition as one of the pioneers of modern poetry.

supporter.zh: 兰波被视为现代诗歌的先驱和革命者，他的诗歌作品打破了传统诗歌的形式和内容限制，开创了象征主义和超现实主义的先河。他提出的'诗人必须打乱所有感官'的理念，对后世诗歌创作产生了深远影响。兰波的生活态度和创作精神，体现了对传统道德和价值观的彻底挑战，以及对自由和真实的不懈追求。他的诗歌作品，尤其是《地狱一季》和《灵光集》，展现了他对人类精神世界的深刻洞察和对诗歌艺术的极致探索。
supporter.en: Rimbaud is regarded as a pioneer and revolutionary of modern poetry, whose works broke through the formal and content limitations of traditional poetry, paving the way for Symbolism and Surrealism. His concept that 'the poet must make himself a seer' by 'disordering all the senses' has had a profound influence on subsequent poetic creation. Rimbaud's attitude toward life and creative spirit embodied a complete challenge to traditional morality and values, as well as an unwavering pursuit of freedom and authenticity. His poetic works, particularly 'A Season in Hell' and 'Illuminations', demonstrate his deep insight into the human spiritual world and his ultimate exploration of the art of poetry.

critic.zh: 批评者认为兰波的生活放荡不羁，缺乏责任感，他的诗歌作品虽然形式创新，但内容常常晦涩难懂，缺乏深度。他的早逝和放弃诗歌创作被一些人视为是对自己才华的浪费。此外，兰波与魏尔伦的关系以及他的同性恋行为在当时的社会环境下引起了争议，被一些人视为道德败坏。他的商业生涯也被批评者视为是对诗人理想的背叛，认为他放弃了艺术追求而转向了物质利益。
critic.en: Critics argue that Rimbaud's life was dissolute and lacked responsibility. While his poetic works were formally innovative, their content was often obscure and difficult to understand, lacking depth. His early death and abandonment of poetry were seen by some as a waste of his talent. Additionally, his relationship with Verlaine and his homosexual behavior caused controversy in the social context of the time, being regarded by some as moral corruption. His business career was criticized by some as a betrayal of the poet's ideal, believing he abandoned artistic pursuits for material gain.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，兰波被定义为一位复杂的文学天才和叛逆者。他的诗歌作品对现代文学产生了深远影响，被誉为'现代诗歌之父'。兰波的生活经历，从早年的诗歌创作到中年的商业活动，展现了他多面性和复杂性。在流行文化中，兰波常常被视为反叛和自由的象征，他的形象被多次出现在电影、音乐和艺术作品中。历史学界对兰波的研究不仅关注他的诗歌成就，也探讨他的生活选择和人格特质，试图理解这位短暂而辉煌的文学天才。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Rimbaud is defined as a complex literary genius and rebel. His poetic works have had a profound impact on modern literature, earning him the title 'father of modern poetry'. Rimbaud's life experience, from his early poetic creation to his middle-aged business activities, demonstrates his multifaceted and complex nature. In popular culture, Rimbaud is often regarded as a symbol of rebellion and freedom, his image appearing repeatedly in films, music, and art works. Historical research on Rimbaud not only focuses on his poetic achievements but also explores his life choices and personality traits, attempting to understand this brief yet brilliant literary genius.

self.zh: 诗人必须打乱所有感官，通过'长期、巨大、有意识的放纵'，达到'灵光'状态。
self.en: The poet must make himself a seer through a long, immense, and reasoned derangement of all the senses.

others.zh: 兰波是现代诗歌中最伟大的心灵，他比任何人更早地看到了现代性的本质。
others.en: Rimbaud is the greatest mind in modern poetry, who saw the essence of modernity earlier than anyone else.
